source.title: U.S. has used nearly all its stockpile of long-range missiles in Iran war, sources say

summary: Two sources tell CBS the Army has used virtually all of its ATACMS and PrSM missiles; Reuters reported it first. Officials call Patriot and THAAD the most pressing concern.

claims.attribution: two sources with direct knowledge (CBS News)
claims.quote: Specifically, the U.S. has used virtually all of its Army Tactical Missile Systems, known as ATACMS, and Precision Strike Missiles, the sources said.

U.S. officials said there are limited inventories of the ATACMS and Precision Strike Missiles, and that the most pressing concern involves the number of Patriot and Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) interceptors, which have been used faster than the industry can replace them.
